name: Rachel Hafuringu
original_name: レイチェル・ハーフリング
source:
Although still young, she's known as the best wizard in the capital. And a woman of mature sex appeal.

As sexy as she is, she is also very maternal showering [url=/c42047]tomohiro[/url] with plenty of affection. Rachel often leads Tomohiro gently during sex but a more mischievous side may appear and a punishment might be in order.

A natural airhead, but when the time comes she can be relied on.

She is close to her younger sister [url=/c23640]Cature[/url] always watching over her with affection. She often times has to gently restrain her sister who can be wild at times, guiding her in the right direction.

[Translated from [url=https://hadashi.product.co.jp/3ping/char.html]the game's Official Homepage[/url].]
